sql: select 'order' k, market_ticker, side||' '||action||' '||limit_price||'x'||quantity v, status, created_at::text t from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and (created_at > '2026-09-29 12:17' or status='resting') union all select 'fill', market_ticker, side||' '||action||' '||price||'x'||quantity, '', filled_at::text from fills where filled_at > '2026-09-29 12:17' union all (select distinct on (market_ticker) 'pos', market_ticker, quantity::text||' r='||coalesce(realized_pnl::text,''), (raw_json ? 'settled_time')::text, captured_at::text from positions where market_ticker in ('KXANTHVREQ-28SEP26-T9P5','KXGOOGVREQ-28SEP26-T13','KXEURUSD-26SEP2910-B1.133','KXUSDJPY-26SEP2910-B157.875') order by market_ticker, captured_at desc) union all select 'now', '', '', '', now()::text order by t desc limit 60
